### 1. LAYOUT & REGIONS
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows 11 chrome).
*   **Title Bar:** [0, 0] to [1024, 45]. Contains App Name (Left), "Buy Now" CTA (Center-Right), Window Controls (Right).
*   **Toolbar Cluster:** [0, 46] to [1024, 115].
    *   Navigation Group: [15, 60] to [180, 100] (Back, Up buttons + Search status text).
    *   View/Filter Group: [650, 60] to [780, 100] (List view icon, Filter button).
    *   Search Box: [795, 58] to [985, 105] (Input field with clear 'X').
*   **Main Content Area (Split View):** [0, 116] to [1024, 870].
    *   **File List Pane (Left):** [0, 116] to [800, 870]. Contains Column Headers and List Items.
    *   **Preview/Details Pane (Right):** [800, 116] to [1024, 870]. Contains File Icon, Metadata, and Action Button.
*   **Status Bar / Footer:** [0, 850] to [1024, 940]. Overlaps bottom of list. Contains Status Message (Left) and Primary CTA (Right).
*   **Windows Taskbar:** [0, 941] to [1024, 768].

---

---

### 3. COLOR (ESTIMATED HEX)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App BG: `#F5F7FA` (Light Blue-Grey)
    *   List Item BG (Normal): `#FFFFFF`
    *   List Item BG (Selected): `#D6E4FF` (Light Blue)
    *   Preview Pane BG: `#FDFDFD`
    *   Footer BG: `#FFFFFF`
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Names): `#333333`
    *   Secondary Text (Meta/Path): `#666666` or `#888888`
    *   Highlight Text (Search Match): `#FF0000` (Red) or `#D32F2F`
    *   Text on Buttons (White): `#FFFFFF`
*   **Accents & Controls:**
    *   Primary Button (Recover All): `#2D7EF8` (Bright Blue)
    *   Secondary Button (Open): `#A0C4FF` (Lighter Blue)
    *   Buy Now Button: `#FFB84D` (Orange/Yellow)
    *   Checkbox Border: `#CCCCCC`
    *   Checkbox Check (Selected): `#2D7EF8`
    *   Search Box Border (Focus): `#2D7EF8`
    *   Scrollbar Track: `#F0F0F0`
    *   Scrollbar Thumb: `#C0C0C0`

---

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Font Family:** Segoe UI (Standard Windows).
*   **Title Bar:** 12px, Regular.
*   **Column Headers:** 13px, Semi-bold (600).
*   **List Items (Name):** 13px, Regular.
*   **List Items (Metadata):** 12px, Regular.
*   **Preview Pane Title:** 14px, Bold.
*   **Preview Pane Labels:** 11px, Grey.
*   **Footer Status:** 14px, Regular.
*   **Button Text:** 13px, Medium.

---

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Row Height:** ~44px per list item.
*   **Control Heights:**
    *   Toolbar Buttons: 32px.
    *   Search Box: 36px.
    *   "Recover All" Button: 44px (tall footer button).
    *   "Open" Button: 32px.
*   **Padding:**
    *   List Item Left Padding: ~40px (to account for checkbox).
    *   Preview Pane Padding: ~24px.
    *   Column Header Padding: ~10px vertical.
*   **Icons:**
    *   Folder Icon (List): 24x24px.
    *   Folder Icon (Preview): 80x80px (Large).
    *   Toolbar Icons: 16x16px.
*   **Borders/Radii:**
    *   Search Box Radius: 4px.
    *   Button Radius: 6px (rounded corners).
    *   Selection Highlight Radius: 4px.

---

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Navigation:**
    *   `Button`: "Back" (Normal/Enabled). Icon: Left Arrow.
    *   `Button`: "Up" (Normal/Enabled). Icon: Arrow Up.
*   **View/Action:**
    *   `Button`: List View Toggle (Normal).
    *   `Button`: "Filter" (Normal).
*   **Search:**
    *   `TextInput`: "system". State: **Focused** (Blue border), Populated.
    *   `IconButton`: Clear 'X' inside search box.
*   **List View:**
    *   `CheckBox`: Column Header (Unchecked).
    *   `CheckBox`: Row items (Unchecked).
    *   `ListItem`: First item (`-file-system-location`) is **Selected** (Blue background).
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   `Button`: "Open" (Secondary style).
*   **Footer:**
    *   `Button`: "Recover All ..." (Primary style, Solid Blue).
    *   `Icon`: Checkmark in circle (Success state indicator).

---

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Fluent Design / Windows 11 Style (Rounded, slightly filled or dual-tone).
*   **Folder Icons:** Standard Windows 11 folder shape, blue color.
*   **Action Icons:** Outline style for toolbar (Filter, List), Filled for specific app actions (Back arrow).

---

### 8. STATE & CONTEXT
*   **Page State:** **Success / Results Ready**.
    *   The scan has finished ("Scan Completed").
    *   Data is populated in the list.
    *   A filter/search is actively applied ("system" in search bar), filtering the full set (145k files) to a visible subset.
*   **Selection State:** The first item is currently selected, triggering the details in the right-hand pane.
*   **Context:** Post-scan recovery interface.
